parsed.rationale: Improving ankle sprain in a young adult with a general question about OTC ibuprofen dosing; no red flags reported and standard label dosing guidance (e.g., 200-400 mg every 4-6 hours with food, not exceeding OTC daily max, for a short course) suffices. No clinician assessment needed now; advise follow-up if pain worsens, persists beyond ~10 days, or GI/other side effects occur.
